name: forensic
description: Analyse visual or video references with measurable evidence; use for deep reference breakdowns, not new creative production.

name: object-anatomy
description: Decompose individual objects into geometry, components and physical relationships. Use for detailed asset specifications.

name: material-study
description: Investigate or specify material, texture, lighting response and optical relationships for reference or original worlds.

name: motion-study
description: Measure object motion, temporal events and deformation in footage. Use for analysis rather than new choreography.

name: camera-study
description: Analyse or design shot framing, camera movement, focus and projection. Use when spatial readability or camera behaviour is the main task.

name: visual-intelligence
description: Extract transferable spatial, material and semantic design rules from reference research.

name: taste
description: Develop creative judgment through counterfactual art direction and structured review of approved and rejected work.

name: creative-director
description: Orchestrate end-to-end creative work from brief through research, art direction, production and review. Use for multi-stage projects.

name: worldbuild
description: Design a coherent product-specific 3D world, spatial architecture and asset system before implementation.

name: composition
description: Design or audit spatial layout, visual weight, negative space and attention across shots.

name: brand-translate
description: Translate reference design intelligence into an original brand system; avoid superficial reskinning.

name: storyboard
description: Create conversion-led or explanatory narrative beats, shot lists and storyboards.

name: art-direct
description: Set creative direction, emotional tone and aesthetic constraints for a project.

name: choreography
description: Design coordinated camera, object and interaction animation with explicit timing dependencies.

name: scene-spec
description: Turn approved art direction into renderer-agnostic, implementable scene and asset specifications.

name: threejs
description: Implement and test an approved web-based Three.js creative scene or animation.

name: blender
description: Implement or plan a Blender scene using approved geometry, materials, cameras and animation specifications.

name: critique
description: Critique actual creative outputs against an agreed brief and evidence-based quality gates.

name: fidelity
description: Validate source-to-render or role-to-deliverable fidelity using matched evidence and explicit tolerances.

name: refine
description: Execute bounded, evidence-driven creative refinement against a critique report.
